run_doctest_object_ext: run the doctest suite that validates Boost.Python object extension attribute and item access functions
test_obj_getattr_setattr: test getting and setting attributes on a Python object using obj_getattr and obj_setattr from object_ext
test_obj_getitem_setitem: test getting and setting dictionary items using obj_getitem and obj_setitem from object_ext
test_obj_moveattr_moveitem: test moving attributes and dictionary items to new keys using obj_moveattr and obj_moveitem from object_ext
test_obj_delattr: test deleting attributes from a Python object using obj_delattr and obj_objdelattr from object_ext
